limitations: P1 — Printed level score direction contradicts highest-score selection — Counterreading: Release wa5 correctly weights excellent highest; historical baseline path unavailable.

P1 — Printed level score direction contradicts highest-score selection — Counterevidence and scope: Directly read released wa5 lines63-71: weights[1,.75,.5,.25,0] give the correct direction. This helper alone is not the historical baseline evaluation path; regression inference does not establish every compared method used Eq1.

P2 — Correlation loss differs between equation and release — Counterevidence and scope: Finite epsilon and low variance perturb the idealized identity; it is not claimed exact for degenerate vectors. Same optimum is retained and no failed training or measured RMSE is inferred. Global tensor reduction is a release fact, historical dimension-wise training protocol unresolved.

P3 — Pretraining component counts sum to50592, not50952 — Counterevidence and scope: A transposed digit in either the total or a component is possible. No construction manifest identifies which number reflects actual training and no measurable training effect follows.
Limitations: Historical baseline paths, folds and raw ratings unavailable.
